en.title: Maximum Contiguous Skill Sum with Equal Counts of Two Employee Types
en.description:
Employees are arranged by index, and each expertise is 0 or 1. Choose a contiguous range in which the two types have equal counts, and maximize the total skill. Choosing nobody is allowed and gives 0.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line n skill values, and the third line n 0/1 expertise flags. The original text gave no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤n≤200000, −10^9≤skill≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: Count expertise 1 as +1 and 0 as −1, and maintain the prefix count difference. For each difference value keep the minimum skill prefix sum, and update the answer with the current skill sum minus that minimum.
